name: Multi-Camera Angles (/angles)
makes: Re-shoots a user's one-take clip as a bold multi-camera edit with new lenses and angles, keeping the people, performance, words, timing and original audio.

steps.name: Break the take down, then plan shots
steps.cheap: Claude on the plan (free to us)

steps.name: Generate
steps.cheap: `gemini_omni_flash_1_2` mode `edit`, 360p (source 3-15 s, up to 7 image refs): the same 7.5 credits per 10 s tier as its quoted reference-to-video; the edit price itself is not quoted, re-quote first

prompts.label: Multi-camera prompt template
One-angle prompt template
Audio restore command
prompts.text:
&& ffmpeg -v error -y -i edit.mp4 -i src.mp4 -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k \
        -shortest -movflags +faststart final.mp4 \
     && curl -f -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: video/mp4' -H 'If-None-Match: *' --upload-file final.mp4

price: Quotes by length at the chosen resolution. `seedance_2_5` video_edit is not quoted in `_prices.md`; its nearest quote is the omni_reference draft (480p, 10 s) at 30 credits and 1080p at 160. Treat a 10 s 1080p re-shoot as likely near 160: re-quote before running.
cheap_price: about 160 -> 7.5 per 10 s (Gemini edit 360p, quote first)
